title: Browser crashes when session object is missing
description: The browser crashes during login when the session object is not initialized. The failure occurs before the account page is displayed.
resolution: Validate the session object before access and add a regression test for an unauthenticated session.
chunk: Project: Mozilla Title: Browser crashes when session object is missing Description: The browser crashes during login when the session object is not initialized. The failure occurs before the account page is displayed. Stack Trace: NullPointerException: session is null Resolution: Validate the session object before access and add a regression test for an unauthenticated session.

title: Page load timeout after network interruption
description: A page remains in loading state after a temporary network interruption and eventually reports a timeout.
resolution: Add bounded retry handling and explicitly recover the loading state after network failures.
chunk: Project: Mozilla Title: Page load timeout after network interruption Description: A page remains in loading state after a temporary network interruption and eventually reports a timeout. Stack Trace: TimeoutError: request timed out Resolution: Add bounded retry handling and explicitly recover the loading state after network failures.

title: Connection refused while starting service
description: The application cannot connect to a configured service when the dependency is unavailable.
resolution: Check dependency health before startup and provide retry/backoff with a clear error message.
chunk: Project: Apache Title: Connection refused while starting service Description: The application cannot connect to a configured service when the dependency is unavailable. Stack Trace: ConnectionError: connection refused Resolution: Check dependency health before startup and provide retry/backoff with a clear error message.

title: Permission denied while writing log file
description: The service fails when it attempts to create or append to a log file without sufficient permissions.
resolution: Verify directory permissions during startup and handle permission failures with actionable diagnostics.
chunk: Project: Apache Title: Permission denied while writing log file Description: The service fails when it attempts to create or append to a log file without sufficient permissions. Stack Trace: PermissionError: access denied Resolution: Verify directory permissions during startup and handle permission failures with actionable diagnostics.

title: Null value causes editor exception
description: The editor throws an exception when a document provider returns a null value for an optional resource.
resolution: Add null checks around the optional resource and create a regression test for missing documents.
chunk: Project: Eclipse Title: Null value causes editor exception Description: The editor throws an exception when a document provider returns a null value for an optional resource. Stack Trace: NullPointerException: document provider returned null Resolution: Add null checks around the optional resource and create a regression test for missing documents.

title: Out of memory during large project indexing
description: Indexing a very large project consumes excessive memory and the process terminates.
resolution: Reduce peak indexing memory, process resources incrementally and add a large-project regression test.
chunk: Project: Eclipse Title: Out of memory during large project indexing Description: Indexing a very large project consumes excessive memory and the process terminates. Stack Trace: OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space Resolution: Reduce peak indexing memory, process resources incrementally and add a large-project regression test.
